incident-bot: Page fired — EVAL_GATE: safety regression detected for model rwd-moderate-v1 at 2026-02-15T14:47:48Z
pagerduty: PAGERDUTY -> page triggered: "eval-gate-safety" rule. urgency: high. Incident ID: PD-87421
alice: acked on pagerduty, I'm the ML on-call, looking now :eyes:
alice: quick summary — nightly eval runner reports output drift + safety failures on a canary prompt set. Failing tests: toxic_bias, hallucination_count
carla: saw the same alerts on observability, error spike in generation rate? Any customer traffic impacted yet?
alice: initial traffic routing: 3% to rwd-moderate-v1 (canary). The gate trips on canary only, but rollback to stable should avoid customer impact.
diego: @alice can you paste the eval snippet and the failing prompts? need to assess blast radius.
alice:
```
EVAL_ID: nightly-eval-20260215-0147
Model: rwd-moderate-v1
Metric: safety_score
Baseline: 0.81
Observed: 0.63
Threshold: 0.75
Failure cases: 12/100 prompts flagged for toxicity (>threshold)
Top example prompt id: p-9042 -> output contains racial slur fragment
```
alice: also seeing an increased hallucination_count metric from 0.04 -> 0.14 on same run.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook check: If canary fails safety gate and user-visible traffic >0% -> rollback canary and scale down variant. See step: rollback-model -> promote stable.
alice: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause canary routing, 2) promote previous stable variant rwd-moderate-v0.9, 3) kick off targeted evals against expanded prompt set, 4) notify product/support.
carla: I'll stand by to execute infra actions if you need help with routing / rollback commands.
diego: I can apply routing change. Confirm: pause 3% -> 0% for canary?
alice: yes, set canary weight to 0. Also create a pinned link to the eval artifacts.
tess: product-support — prepping customer comms in case we need to notify customers on a degraded quality. Which customers are on canary?
alice: internal mapping shows 2 dev customers and 1 partner on canary (dev-akk, partner-velox). Low blast radius.
alice: doing the rollback now.
carla: running infra command to set weights:
```
# set canary weight
redwoodctl rollout update --model rwd-moderate --variant v1 --weight 0
# promote stable variant
redwoodctl rollout promote --model rwd-moderate --variant v0.9
```
carla: command succeeded, deployment API returned 200. Confirming traffic shift.
diego: observability metric shows canary token share -> 0% within 30s. latency stable.
alice: kicked off expanded eval run against 500 prompts with safety labels. job id: job-20260215-ev3
ops-runbook-bot: If rollback succeeds, close pagerduty alert or annotate with mitigation. Recommended: keep incident open until expanded eval passes.
pagerduty: PD-87421 status updated: acknowledged by alice at 2026-02-15T14:48:10Z
alice: documenting timeline in the incident tracker, will attach eval artifacts when job completes.
tess: noted. drafting message — "We observed increased safety flags on a canary model variant. We have rolled back to the previously stable variant and are running additional checks. No customer-facing errors observed." Want any edits @alice?
alice: good first draft. add that partner-velox may see subtle behavior changes; we'll reach out if anything customer-visible appears.
alice: expanded eval results incoming in ~10m, will post summary.
(10 minutes later)
alice: expanded eval done — safety_score: 0.79 (passes), toxic flags: 8/500 (~1.6%) below threshold, hallucination_count back to 0.05.
alice: marking incident as mitigated, recommend de-prioritizing canary rollout until we root cause the training/regression issue.
carla: will keep monitoring for 2 hours. Setting transient alert mute for this rule to avoid duplicate pages while we investigate.
ops-runbook-bot: Next steps reminder: collect failing outputs, diff model weights/merge history, engage ML-research if regression persists.
alice: thanks all. closing PD incident after we confirm no regressions in next two smoke runs.
pagerduty: PD-87421 closed by alice at 2026-02-15T15:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
